levels.guidance: Context is around 20%. No compaction needed yet. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
Context is around 30%. Keep the main thread lean. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
Context is around 40%. Look for a clean boundary to compact soon. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
Context is around 50%. Compact at the next reasonable stopping point. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.

Context is around 60%. Calls are getting meaningfully more expensive, so compact soon unless you are in a short user-blocking action. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
Context is around 70%. Strongly prefer compacting at the next clean boundary. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
Context is around 80%. Stop after the current thought or tool result and compact as soon as safe. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
Context is around 90%. Stop immediately and compact before doing more work. Use workers or subagents for bounded side work to avoid context bloat.
